x: Our own John Regis earned another medal for his bulging cabinet back home as, teamed with Jarret, Braithwaite and Christie, the Britons took third behind the World Record breaking Americans.
Modesto, USA, 8 May. 100m: 8, M.Adam 10.36 (+3.6). 200m: 1, J.Regis 20.48. 4x100m: Belgrave/Haringey (Adam, Jarrett, Regis, Braithwaite) 39.42.

Rounding into the form of his life, Phil Goedluck raced to a marvellous AAA 200 metres title, 1/100th ahead of Braithwaite of Haringey. Going progressively faster through the rounds, Phil won his heat in 21.66 and semi-final in 21.27 before clinching his first ever AAA title with a best ever 21.16.
